newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian average lending rate rises to 12.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian average lending rate rises to 12.6 pct.

text.p: The Croatian average lending rate rose to 12.6 percent on Monday from 11 percent amid stronger demand for fresh funds.
Daily trade totalled 55.5 million kuna, of which 31.1 million kuna were renewed term deals.
Insurers charged 9.0 percent for one-week to 16 percent for one-month loans.
Interbank rates ranged between 12 percent for two-week funds and a maximum 18 percent for one 30-day loan.
Call money was steady at 10.5 percent.
The central bank calculated its kuna mid-rates for Tuesday slightly firmer at 5.9013 against the dollar and weaker at 3.5737 against the mark. -- Zoran Radosavljevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
